description: Inputs of scripts/price_comparison.py (T-16): our cost per unit versus market prices. Every value has a unit and a source; hardware costs come from config/hardware/*.json, electricity and heat value from config/reference-house.json.

soldShareOfHours.source: results of dotnet run --project src/DigitalHeat.YearRun -- . : 22,661 server-hours / (4 servers x 8,760 h), docs/results/reference-house.md
docs/research/filler-demand.md: base fill rate of interruptible filler marketplaces (assumption built from sources)

hoursPerYear.source: 365 days x 24 h (data: 8,760 hourly values, data/raw/open-meteo/SOURCE.md)

inputTokenShare.source: docs/jobs/llm-summary.md: measured document mix, 91 % input tokens (T-33)

cpu-server.source: docs/jobs/llm-summary.md: 0.92 Wh per 3,629 tokens, laptop CPU, Apertus 8B, scaled to the 1 kW server by equal energy per token

audioHoursPerServerHourFrom.source: config/hardware/*.json field (CPU: whisper.cpp base measured, T-02; L4: whisper-large-v3-turbo, third-party benchmark)

cpu-server.source: docs/jobs/research-sim.md: 1,000 Wh / 0.00409 Wh per task (2D Ising, laptop, T-30); informative only, no market price per task exists

marketPerServerHour.source: data/derived/computing-price.json a1_on_demand_min (Azure Switzerland North D32as v5, scaled to 1 kW, snapshot 2026-11-21)
data/derived/computing-price.json a2_spot_min (Azure Switzerland North spot, scaled to 1 kW)
docs/research/computing-price.md: adopted price (Hetzner dedicated server equivalent)
